receipt.equivalence_review: The author followed the empty block-role query with the actual digital.mcu block, mcu.32-bit part and explicit package record. Exact original N3 mandates BGA for mcu.32-bit; the only pinned MCU block selects STM32F103C8T6 in LQFP-48. Full pinned-catalog inspection confirms no alternate eligible MCU. UNSATISFIED_SELECTION/functions.mcu replays; no invented parts or package substitution.

refusal.reason: The mandatory BGA package for role mcu.32-bit cannot be selected in the pinned catalog. The digital.mcu block search returns only block:mcu-core, whose U1 explicitly selects part:st-stm32f103c8t6. The mcu.32-bit part search likewise returns only that part, bound to package:lqfp-48-stm32; the queried package declares family LQFP-48, not BGA. The BGA package search returns no matches. Substituting this LQFP MCU would violate the explicit mandatory BGA requirement.
